name: Theo
text: Hey mate! Another one?

name: Theo
text: Cheers, new mate!

name: Theo
text: A second driver? Wonderful! Two sets of hands, double the good vibes. I'm Theo. I'd shake your hand but I'm mid-affirmation.

name: Theo
text: You don't talk as much as the other one. Silence is just wisdom that hasn't been published yet.

name: Theo
text: I wrote a poem about people who ride shotgun. It's mostly the word 'shotgun'. Want to hear it? That's the whole poem.

name: Theo
text: Hey mates! Both of you!

name: Theo
text: Cheers, you two!

name: Theo
text: Two of you in one truck! That's carpooling for the soul. Namaste, or whatever the plural is.

name: Theo
text: I jogged 17km this morning. Okay, one kilometre, seventeen times. You two should join me. Or one of you. Or neither. All valid.

name: Theo
text: Having a friend to work with is the real EasyCo benefit. Not that they offer benefits. Cheers!

name: Cici
text: ...Another one.

name: Cici
text: I'm watching. Do you mind?

name: Cici
text: There was one of you. Now there are two. Funny how that happens right when the birds started acting weird.

name: Cici
text: You sit in the passenger seat? Or is that where they put the one who reports back? Hypothetically.

name: Cici
text: I counted the seats in your truck. Two. Coincidence? I wrote 'coincidence' on my wall and crossed it out.

name: Cici
text: ...Both of you. Together. Suspicious.

name: Cici
text: Don't think I didn't notice you came in as a pair.

name: Cici
text: Two deliverers, one truck. The cardboard conspiracy is growing, and now it's organized.

name: Cici
text: You haven't said a word to each other. That's exactly what a rehearsed pair would do.

name: Cici
text: I keep two lists: people I trust and people I suspect. You're both on the second one. Don't take it personally. Everyone is.

name: Fortino
text: Sigh... Oh. Hello. Another person to be nervous around.

name: Fortino
text: I'll just be here... again...

name: Fortino
text: Are you the one who delivers flowers? No? Dirt? ...I'm still working on a gift for Ellie. Dirt is still on the table.

name: Fortino
text: You seem confident. Could you say hello to Ellie for me? Or teach me how to be confident. Either. In seventeen months.

name: Fortino
text: Someone told me love is knowing which direction a person is in at all times. I know Ellie's direction. It's always 'away from me'.

name: Fortino
text: Sigh... Two of you? That's twice the eyes to see me avoiding Ellie.

name: Fortino
text: I'll just be here... but now with witnesses.

name: Fortino
text: You two look like you have each other figured out. Do you ever wish you had a script? I've written four. Ellie ignores all of them.

name: Fortino
text: If one of you distracts Ellie, the other could carry my dirt over. It's a plan. Technically a bad one.

name: Fortino
text: It must be nice to arrive somewhere with someone. I arrive everywhere with a lot of fear.

name: Ellie
text: Huh?! A new one! Do you come with the old one?

name: Ellie
text: Yeah! Okay! Great! Good! Bye!

name: Ellie
text: I'm Ellie! You look like someone who has never been bitten by a croissant. Lucky! Do you like bread? Do you like bread feelings?

name: Ellie
text: Did you know a year has fifty hours? Because of the clocks! The second driver always knows these things. Are you the second driver? Write that down.

name: Ellie
text: I tried to sell a muffin to a lamp today. The lamp was very polite. We are getting married in the spring, which is next to Tuesday.

name: Ellie
text: Huh?! Two! TWO! Quick, nobody move, I'm counting!

name: Ellie
text: Yeah! Okay! Great! Good! Bye, both-ers!

name: Ellie
text: You are two people! I only know how to talk to one at a time. Okay: you first. No, you. No, me. Hello!

name: Ellie
text: If I give each of you half a pastry, that is one pastry. If I give each of you a whole one, that is two! Math is a wonderful lie.

name: Ellie
text: Together you make a team! Like me and my feelings! Mostly my feelings are winning.

name: Fit
text: Well, hello. Fancy seeing a new face here.

name: Fit
text: Love watching you walk away. Again.

name: Fit
text: You must be the passenger. I'd call you the co-pilot, but I'd rather call you the other love of my life. Cheesy? I know.

name: Fit
text: Are you a parking ticket? Because you've got 'fine' written all over you.

name: Fit
text: Is it hot in here or is it just the heater in your truck? Either way, I'm into it.

name: Fit
text: Oh my. Two of you. My heart can't handle the extra surface area.

name: Fit
text: Love watching you BOTH walk away. Synchronized.

name: Fit
text: I can't decide who to flirt with first, so I'll go with both. It's called efficiency. Look it up.

name: Fit
text: You two are like peanut butter and... some other sandwich ingredient that goes with peanut butter. I got nervous.

name: Fit
text: Don't worry, I'm happy to share the compliments. Like I said: efficiency.

name: Tooey
text: Howdy, whippersnapper! Another one, eh?

name: Tooey
text: You be careful now, young one!

name: Tooey
text: Jeepers, there's two of you now. In my day one fella did the whole route, uphill, both ways. Don't let them work you too hard.

name: Tooey
text: You've got the look of a good passenger. Quiet. Observant. Seb used to say the best part of the drive is the view. Wasn't much of a view, mind you.

name: Tooey
text: Golly, I can't tell if you're a ghost or my eyes are going. Probably both. Heh-heh.

name: Tooey
text: Well, well! Two whippersnappers at once!

name: Tooey
text: You be careful now, the pair of you! Heh-heh.

name: Tooey
text: Never seen two folks in that old truck. Always thought it only had room for one lonely soul. Nice to see it full.

name: Tooey
text: Tell old Foreman I said hello. No wait, tell him he owes me a snowball. Heh-heh.

name: Tooey
text: Having a friend along is the best way to travel, whippersnappers. Seb always said so. Talked to the dashboard, mostly.

name: Reed
text: Oh? Seb? No... Seb's friend? New Seb?

name: Reed
text: Sorry, who were you again?

name: Reed
text: Hey, it's me, Reed! Wait, we've met. Or haven't. You're the second one? I only remember one of you at a time. Sorry.

name: Reed
text: Your truck has two seats! I've been meaning to tell you that for a while. Wait, did I already tell you? I think I told the other one.

name: Reed
text: I fixed the cup holder on your passenger seat. Or I thought about fixing it. Same thing, effort-wise.

name: Reed
text: Oh? Wait, there are two of you? Or am I seeing double again?

name: Reed
text: Sorry, which of you was I talking to?

name: Reed
text: Two of you! I can only remember one name. Is it Seb? It's usually Seb. Pick one of you to be Seb.

name: Reed
text: Oh good, you brought a friend. Now when I forget, someone else can remember. That's called teamwork.

name: Reed
text: I'm all out of air for your tires. And for your friend's tires. Surprisingly, the same amount of air.

name: Fives
text: Oy! Another one! Careful, don't talk to my twin about money.

name: Fives
text: Say hi to my twin!

name: Fives
text: Two drivers now, huh? That's twice the chance Sixo corners one of you with a business idea. Sorry in advance.

name: Fives
text: I'm Fives. Yes, I'm the quiet twin. No, I don't want to talk about the vending-machine-selling-vending-machines idea.

name: Fives
text: You look like someone who reads the fine print. Keep that. It's the only thing that saved me from Sixo's last investment.

name: Fives
text: Oy! A pair! Funny, I'm one half of one of those.

name: Fives
text: Say hi to my twin! Both of you, take turns.

name: Fives
text: You two travel together, huh? Like my twin and me. Except nobody asked you to co-sign anything.

name: Fives
text: Sixo would call you a dynamic duo and then ask you for money. I'm just saying the first half.

name: Fives
text: Two of you, one truck, zero business ideas. That's the dream. Hold onto it.

name: Sixo
text: Yo! A new face for my pitch!

name: Sixo
text: Tell my twin I said hi.

name: Sixo
text: Second driver! Perfect. Do you have a minute? It'll only cost you the rest of your afternoon.

name: Sixo
text: Business idea: the driver gets paid per delivery, the passenger gets paid per delivery observed. Observing is a job, I swear.

name: Sixo
text: I'd offer you a deal, but I haven't thought of one yet. Give me a sec. ... ... Do you have a pen?

name: Sixo
text: Yo! Two customers! I mean friends! Customers! Friends!

name: Sixo
text: Tell my twin I said hi. And bring a friend next time. Oh, you did.

name: Sixo
text: A duo! Ever heard of 'buy one, get one'? I don't do that, but you two can pretend I do.

name: Sixo
text: Investment opportunity: I take half of what you earn, and you both get the feeling of belonging to something. It's called a team!

name: Sixo
text: Pitch time. Two heads are better than one, which means I can sell the same idea twice. Efficiency!

name: Ada
text: G-greetings. A n-new face. H-hello.

name: Ada
text: G-g-goodbye, f-friend.

name: Ada
text: Y-you must be the o-other one. I'm A-Ada. I h-have f-feelings now. S-several. W-would you l-like to hear them? N-no pressure.

name: Ada
text: T-two of you m-makes the truck l-lighter, I th-think. Or w-warmer. I'm not s-sure which. B-both are g-good.

name: Ada
text: I k-keep flowers for p-people who sit quietly. Y-you look like one. H-here is... my imagination of a f-flower. Do you l-like it?

name: Ada
text: G-greetings, b-both of you. Th-that is a l-lot of f-friends at once.

name: Ada
text: G-g-goodbye. Th-thank you for c-coming t-together.

name: Ada
text: W-when you c-come in t-together, the s-shop feels m-more... full. I d-don't have a w-word for it. M-maybe 'warm'.

name: Ada
text: I w-wish I had t-two hands to wave g-goodbye with. I d-do. But I wave w-with only one. Th-that's rude. I will fix it.

name: Ada
text: S-someone once t-told me fr-friends come in p-pairs. Th-that is a l-lovely t-thing to be t-told.

name: Foreman
text: Aye! Another snapper!

name: Foreman
text: Carry on, guppy!

name: Foreman
text: Two drivers on the one truck? Is EasyCo that skint? Ye'll be sharing the same wee hat next. Call me Foreman.

name: Foreman
text: Passenger, eh? Ye ken the job is tae sit still and say naught. Perfect. Ye'd have been welcome on my boat.

name: Foreman
text: If ye see old Tooey, tell 'em I said ye drive better than they walk. Heh-heh.

name: Foreman
text: Aye! A whole school o' ye! Two, anyway.

name: Foreman
text: Carry on, the pair o' ye!

name: Foreman
text: Two fish in the one tin. Dinnae tell me ye share a seat belt tae. Cracking efficiency, that.

name: Foreman
text: If ye both pull yer weight, ye'll be home before the snow thaws. Heh-heh. Nae pressure.

name: Foreman
text: Take it from me, snappers: a good fishing trip is nae good without a pal tae blame the empty bucket on.

name: Gus
text: Hmph. Another one.

name: Gus
text: Now go away. You too.

name: Gus
text: Oh good, a second customer. Twice the disappointment and exactly the same price. That'll be $price

name: Gus
text: The passenger! The one who contributes nothing but opinions. Tell the driver fuel isn't free. Neither is your presence. $price

name: Gus
text: I don't know which of you is paying, and I don't care. Somebody give me $price

name: Gus
text: Hmph. Two. Wonderful.

name: Gus
text: Now go away. Both. Together. Quietly.

name: Gus
text: Two people for one tank of fuel. Does the truck run on companionship? It doesn't. That'll be $price

name: Gus
text: You came in as a pair, so I'll insult you as a pair: you're both awful. Equally. That's $price

name: Gus
text: If one of you pays, the other gets to pretend they would have. Classic. $price
